cover_fields.explanatoryNotes: Please be advised that, for any issuers listed on this report where it appears we did not vote and/or missed the vote deadline, we intentionally chose not to vote the proxy in those instances as we were no longer shareholders of said issuers as of the date of the meeting. Nitorum Capital, L.P. generally abstains from voting in those instances where the funds it advises are no longer involved in the position on the meeting date. For avoidance of doubt, Nitorum Capital, L.P. did not miss any voting deadlines and/or fail to timely vote any proxies during the period from July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2024.
